import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.socbench.example"

# Retrieve inventory across all locations and identify items with insufficient stock.
inventory_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/inventory/status")
inventory_response.raise_for_status()
inventory = inventory_response.json()

# Generate demand predictions from available historical data.
historical_data = []
for item in inventory.get("items", []):
    historical_data.append({
        "date": "2026-10-22",
        "quantitySold": item.get("quantity", 0),
        "itemId": item["id"],
    })

forecast_response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/analytics/forecast",
    json={"historicalData": historical_data},
)
forecast_response.raise_for_status()
forecast = forecast_response.json().get("forecast", [])

# Treat items with no stock as insufficient; use predicted demand as the restock quantity.
stock_by_id = {item["id"]: item.get("quantity", 0) for item in inventory.get("items", [])}
restock_items = [
    {"itemId": prediction["itemId"], "quantity": prediction.get("predictedQuantity", 0)}
    for prediction in forecast
    if stock_by_id.get(prediction["itemId"], 0) <= 0
    and prediction.get("predictedQuantity", 0) > 0
]

order_result = None
if restock_items:
    order_response = requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/orders/new",
        json={
            "items": restock_items,
            "deliveryDate": "2026-10-29",
        },
    )
    order_response.raise_for_status()
    order_result = order_response.json()

# Retrieve supply-chain segments and the available performance metrics.
overview_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/supplychain/overview")
overview_response.raise_for_status()
supply_chain_overview = overview_response.json()

metrics_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/performance/metrics")
metrics_response.raise_for_status()
performance_metrics = metrics_response.json()

# Review waste reports alongside the restocking and supply-chain information.
waste_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/waste/reports")
waste_response.raise_for_status()
waste_reports = waste_response.json()

        current_demand = zone.get("demand", 0)
        if not zone_id:

            response = requests.post(

        threshold = current_demand * 1.10
        response = requests.patch(
